about: Meal and exercise library for the built-in plan builder. Recipes written for this project. Nutrition from USDA FoodData Central (SR Legacy, public domain CC0 1.0: U.S. Department of Agriculture, Agricultural Research Service, FoodData Central, 2019, fdc.nal.usda.gov), except items marked "label". Prices are rough Coles estimates in AUD. Rebuild with tools/build_library.py.

dishes.name: Chicken and vegetable stir-fry with rice
steps: Cook the rice.
Slice the chicken thinly. Stir-fry it in a hot pan with the oil until cooked through, then set aside.
Stir-fry the vegetables with the garlic and ginger for 4 minutes.
Add the chicken and soy sauce, toss, and serve on the rice.
dishes.kid: Serve the chicken, rice and vegetables in separate piles.

dishes.name: Beef and broccoli stir-fry with rice
steps: Cook the rice.
Stir-fry the beef in a very hot pan with the oil in two batches, 2 minutes each. Set aside.
Stir-fry the broccoli and capsicum with the garlic and a splash of water for 4 minutes.
Return the beef, add the soy sauce, toss and serve on the rice.

dishes.name: Spaghetti bolognese
steps: Fry the chopped onion, grated carrot and garlic in the oil for 5 minutes.
Add the mince and brown it, breaking it up.
Add the passata and simmer for 20 minutes.
Cook the pasta, then serve with the sauce and a little grated cheese.
dishes.kid: Plain pasta with a little sauce on the side.

dishes.name: Turkey chilli with rice
steps: Cook the rice.
Fry the onion and capsicum in the oil for 5 minutes, then brown the mince.
Add the taco seasoning, tomatoes and drained beans. Simmer for 15 minutes.
Serve on the rice with a spoon of sour cream.
dishes.kid: Take a portion out before adding the seasoning, if needed.

dishes.name: Chicken fajita wraps
steps: Slice the chicken, capsicum and onion into strips. Toss the chicken with the seasoning.
Fry the chicken in the oil for 6 minutes, add the vegetables and cook 4 minutes more.
Warm the wraps. Everyone fills their own with the chicken, lettuce and sour cream.
dishes.kid: Plain chicken strips and cheese in a wrap.

dishes.name: Beef tacos with salad
steps: Brown the mince in the oil. Add the seasoning and a splash of water and simmer for 5 minutes.
Shred the lettuce, dice the tomato and grate the cheese.
Everyone fills their own wraps.
dishes.kid: Mince with cheese, no seasoning on theirs if needed.

dishes.name: Butter chicken with rice and peas
steps: Cook the rice, adding the peas for the last 3 minutes.
Brown the diced chicken in a pan for 6 minutes.
Add the sauce and simmer for 10 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve with the rice and peas.

dishes.name: Chickpea and spinach curry with rice
steps: Cook the rice.
Fry the onion and garlic in the oil for 5 minutes. Stir in the curry powder for 1 minute.
Add the drained chickpeas, tomatoes and coconut milk. Simmer for 12 minutes.
Stir the spinach through until it wilts. Serve on the rice.

dishes.name: Red lentil dahl with rice
steps: Cook the rice.
Fry the onion, grated carrot, garlic and ginger in the oil for 5 minutes. Add the curry powder.
Add the rinsed lentils, tomatoes and stock. Simmer for 20 minutes, stirring now and then, until thick.
Serve on the rice.

dishes.name: Baked salmon with potatoes and greens
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C. Cut the potatoes into chunks, toss with the oil and roast for 30 minutes.
Add the salmon to the tray for the last 12 minutes, with lemon slices on top.
Steam the beans and broccoli. Serve together.

dishes.name: Lemon chicken tray bake
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C. Cut the vegetables into chunks.
Toss the chicken and vegetables with the oil, lemon juice, salt and pepper on a big tray.
Roast for 35 to 40 minutes, turning once, until golden and cooked through.

dishes.name: Honey soy chicken drumsticks with rice and corn
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C. Toss the drumsticks with the honey and soy sauce on a lined tray.
Bake for 40 to 45 minutes, turning once.
Cook the rice. Warm the corn and steam the broccoli.

dishes.name: Lamb koftas with couscous and salad
steps: Mix the mince with the finely chopped onion, salt and pepper. Shape into small sausages.
Fry the koftas in the oil for 8 to 10 minutes, turning, until cooked through.
Pour boiling water over the couscous (same amount as the couscous), cover for 5 minutes, then fluff.
Serve with chopped cucumber and tomato and the tzatziki.

dishes.name: Greek chicken souvlaki wraps
steps: Dice the chicken and toss with the oil, lemon juice, salt and dried oregano if you have it.
Fry for 8 minutes until cooked through.
Warm the bread and fill with chicken, salad and tzatziki.

dishes.name: Vegetable frittata with salad
steps: Heat the oven grill. Fry the chopped zucchini and capsicum in the oil in an ovenproof pan for 5 minutes, then add the spinach.
Pour in the beaten eggs and crumble over the feta. Cook on low for 8 minutes.
Grill for 5 minutes until set and golden. Serve with salad.

dishes.name: Tuna pasta bake
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C. Cook the pasta for 2 minutes less than the packet says. Add the peas for the last 2 minutes.
Drain and mix with the drained tuna, corn and passata in a baking dish.
Top with the cheese and bake for 15 minutes.

dishes.name: Pesto chicken pasta with greens
steps: Cook the pasta, adding the broccoli for the last 3 minutes.
Fry the sliced chicken in the oil for 8 minutes until cooked.
Drain the pasta, then toss with the chicken, pesto and spinach.

dishes.name: Minestrone soup with bread
steps: Fry the chopped onion, carrot and celery in the oil for 6 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, stock, beans and zucchini and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add the pasta and cook for 10 minutes more. Serve with bread.

dishes.name: Slow-cooker beef and vegetable stew with mash
steps: In the morning, put the diced beef, chopped vegetables, tomatoes and stock in the slow cooker. Cook on low for 8 hours.
Boil the peeled potatoes for 15 minutes, then mash with the milk and butter.
Serve the stew on the mash.

dishes.name: Shepherd’s pie
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C. Boil the peeled potatoes for 15 minutes and mash with the milk and butter.
Brown the mince with the onion. Add the tomato paste, stock and frozen vegetables and simmer for 10 minutes.
Put the mince in a baking dish, top with the mash and bake for 20 minutes.

dishes.name: Sausages with mash and vegetables
steps: Boil the peeled potatoes for 15 minutes, then mash with the milk and butter.
Cook the sausages in a pan for 12 to 15 minutes, turning.
Steam the carrots and peas. Serve together.

dishes.name: Egg fried rice with vegetables
steps: Cook the rice (or use cold leftover rice).
Scramble the eggs in a hot pan with half the oil, then set aside.
Stir-fry the frozen vegetables in the rest of the oil for 4 minutes. Add the rice and fry for 3 minutes.
Stir in the eggs, soy sauce and sliced spring onion.

dishes.name: Teriyaki chicken rice bowls
steps: Cook the rice. Boil the edamame for 3 minutes.
Fry the diced chicken for 8 minutes, then add the teriyaki sauce and cook 2 minutes until sticky.
Serve on the rice with grated carrot, sliced cucumber and the edamame in separate piles.

dishes.name: Teriyaki salmon with rice and greens
steps: Cook the rice. Steam the broccoli and beans.
Fry the salmon skin-side down for 4 minutes, turn and cook 3 minutes more.
Add the teriyaki sauce for the last minute. Serve with the rice and greens.

dishes.name: Korean-style beef mince rice bowls
steps: Cook the rice.
Brown the mince. Add the garlic, ginger, soy sauce, honey and sesame oil and cook for 3 minutes.
Serve on the rice with the coleslaw mix and sliced cucumber.

dishes.name: Thai green chicken curry with rice
steps: Cook the rice.
Fry the curry paste in a pan for 1 minute, add the diced chicken and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the coconut milk, beans and capsicum. Simmer for 10 minutes. Add the fish sauce.
Serve on the rice.

dishes.name: Vietnamese chicken noodle salad
steps: Soak the noodles in boiling water for 5 minutes, then rinse in cold water.
Cook the chicken in a pan for 10 minutes, then slice.
Mix the fish sauce, lemon juice and honey for a dressing.
Serve the noodles, chicken and vegetables with the dressing.

dishes.name: Pork san choy bow
steps: Cook the rice.
Brown the mince in the oil with the garlic and ginger.
Add the grated carrot, sliced spring onion and soy sauce and cook 3 minutes.
Spoon into lettuce cups and serve with the rice.

dishes.name: Wrap pizzas with ham and vegetables
steps: Heat the oven to 220 °C. Spread the wraps with passata.
Top with ham, sliced capsicum and mushrooms, and the cheese.
Bake on trays for 8 to 10 minutes until crisp. Serve with salad.

dishes.name: Black bean burrito bowls
steps: Cook the rice.
Warm the drained beans with the seasoning and a splash of water for 5 minutes.
Serve the rice, beans, corn, diced tomato, avocado and lettuce in a bowl with a squeeze of lemon.

dishes.name: Chicken and vegetable soup
steps: Simmer the chicken in the stock for 15 minutes, then take it out and shred it.
Add the chopped vegetables and pasta to the stock and simmer for 15 minutes.
Return the chicken and serve with bread.

dishes.name: Oven fish and chips with salad
steps: Heat the oven to 220 °C. Cut the potatoes into wedges, toss with the oil and bake for 30 minutes.
Bake the fish for the last 15 to 18 minutes (check the packet).
Serve with salad and lemon.

dishes.name: Steak with jacket potato and salad
steps: Bake the potatoes at 200 °C for about 50 minutes (or microwave for 8 to 10 minutes).
Cook the steak in a hot pan, 3 to 4 minutes each side. Rest it for 5 minutes.
Serve with the potato, sour cream and salad.

dishes.name: Tofu and vegetable noodle stir-fry
steps: Cook the noodles. Cut the tofu into cubes and pat dry.
Fry the tofu in the oil until golden, then set aside.
Stir-fry the vegetables with the garlic and ginger for 4 minutes.
Add the noodles, tofu and soy sauce and toss.

dishes.name: Halloumi and roast vegetable couscous
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C. Roast the chopped pumpkin, zucchini, capsicum and drained chickpeas with the oil for 25 minutes.
Pour boiling water over the couscous, cover for 5 minutes, then fluff.
Fry the sliced halloumi for 2 minutes each side.
Mix the vegetables and spinach through the couscous and top with the halloumi.

dishes.name: Homemade beef burgers with salad
steps: Shape the mince into patties with salt and pepper.
Fry for 4 to 5 minutes each side until cooked through.
Fill the rolls with the patties, cheese, lettuce, tomato and sauce.

dishes.name: Baked potatoes with beans and cheese
steps: Prick the potatoes and microwave for 8 to 12 minutes until soft (or bake at 200 °C for 50 minutes).
Warm the beans. Split the potatoes, top with the beans and grated cheese.
Serve with salad.

dishes.name: Chicken burrito bowls
steps: Cook the rice.
Toss the sliced chicken with the seasoning and fry for 8 minutes.
Warm the beans.
Serve everything in bowls with the corn, tomato, lettuce and sour cream.

dishes.name: Pumpkin and ricotta pasta
steps: Microwave the diced pumpkin with a splash of water for 8 minutes until soft.
Cook the pasta.
Fry the garlic in the oil, add the pumpkin and mash roughly. Stir in the ricotta and a little pasta water.
Toss with the pasta and spinach, and top with cheese.

dishes.name: Overnight oats with berries
steps: The night before, mix the oats, milk and yoghurt in a jar or bowl.
Top with the berries and leave in the fridge overnight.

dishes.name: Porridge with banana
steps: Microwave the oats and milk for 2 to 3 minutes, stirring halfway.
Top with sliced banana and a little honey.

dishes.name: Weet-Bix with milk and fruit
steps: Two Weet-Bix in a bowl with milk and sliced banana.

dishes.name: Eggs on toast
steps: Scramble, poach or fry the eggs.
Serve on buttered toast with sliced tomato.

dishes.name: Yoghurt with muesli and fruit
steps: Spoon the yoghurt into a bowl and top with the muesli and berries.

dishes.name: Avocado and tomato toast
steps: Toast the bread, mash the avocado on top with a squeeze of lemon, and add sliced tomato.

dishes.name: Baked beans on toast
steps: Warm the beans and serve on buttered toast.

dishes.name: Vegemite toast and fruit
steps: Toast with butter and a thin scrape of Vegemite, with an apple.

dishes.name: Peanut butter toast
steps: Toast spread with peanut butter, with an apple on the side.

dishes.name: Scrambled egg and cheese wrap
steps: Scramble the eggs, then roll them in a wrap with the cheese and spinach.

dishes.name: Greek yoghurt with berries and banana
steps: Thaw the berries in the fridge overnight, or give them 30 seconds in the microwave.
Spoon the yoghurt into a bowl and top with the berries and sliced banana.

dishes.name: Scrambled eggs with spinach and tomato
steps: Wilt the spinach in a pan with the oil for a minute.
Pour in the beaten eggs and stir gently over low heat until just set.
Serve with the sliced tomato.

dishes.name: Potato, capsicum and egg hash
steps: Dice the potato small and fry it in the oil, covered, for 10 minutes, turning now and then.
Add the chopped capsicum and onion and cook 5 minutes more until golden.
Make a gap, crack in the egg and cook it the way you like.

dishes.name: Bean, avocado and tomato breakfast plate
steps: Warm the drained beans and corn in the microwave for a minute.
Serve with sliced avocado and tomato, and a squeeze of lemon.

dishes.name: Creamy rice porridge with banana
steps: Use rice cooked the day before (or cook a little extra at dinner).
Microwave the rice with the milk for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring twice, until thick and creamy.
Top with sliced banana.

dishes.name: Cottage cheese with apple and almonds
steps: Chop the apple and roughly chop the almonds.
Spoon the cottage cheese into a bowl and scatter them over.

dishes.name: Chicken salad wrap
steps: Cook a chicken breast (or use leftover chicken) and slice it.
Fill a wrap with the chicken, lettuce, tomato, cheese and a little mayonnaise.

dishes.name: Tuna and salad sandwich
steps: Mix the tuna with the mayonnaise. Make a sandwich with the lettuce and tomato.

dishes.name: Ham, cheese and salad sandwich
steps: Make a sandwich with ham, cheese, lettuce and tomato.

dishes.name: Egg and lettuce sandwich
steps: Hard-boil the eggs for 9 minutes, cool, peel and mash with the mayonnaise.
Make a sandwich with the lettuce.

dishes.name: Hummus and vegetable wrap
steps: Spread the wrap with hummus and fill with grated carrot, cucumber, leaves and chickpeas.

dishes.name: Tuna pasta salad
steps: Cook the pasta, rinse in cold water and mix with everything else. Keeps for 2 days in the fridge.

dishes.name: Cheese, crackers and vegetable sticks
steps: Cut the cheese, carrot and cucumber into sticks. Pack with crackers and an apple.

dishes.name: Bean and cheese quesadilla
steps: Fill a wrap with the beans, corn and cheese, top with another wrap and toast in a dry pan for 2 to 3 minutes each side.
Serve with diced tomato.

dishes.name: Pumpkin soup with bread
steps: Simmer the chopped pumpkin and onion in the stock for 20 minutes.
Blend until smooth and stir in the cream. Serve with bread.

dishes.name: Chicken, rice and vegetable lunch box
steps: Cook the rice and chicken (or use leftovers). Steam the vegetables.
Pack in a container with a dash of soy sauce.

dishes.name: Tuna, rice and corn salad
steps: Use rice cooked the day before.
Mix it with the drained tuna and corn, and the diced cucumber and tomato.
Dress with the lemon juice and oil.

dishes.name: Egg and potato salad
steps: Boil the diced potato for 10 to 12 minutes until tender. Hard-boil the eggs for 9 minutes.
Cool both, chop the eggs, and mix with the potato, mayonnaise and sliced spring onion.
Serve on the salad leaves.

dishes.name: Chickpea, feta and cucumber salad
steps: Rinse and drain the chickpeas.
Mix them with the diced cucumber and tomato and crumbled feta.
Dress with the lemon juice and oil.

dishes.name: Baked potato with beans and cheese
steps: Prick the potato with a fork and microwave it for 8 to 10 minutes, turning halfway, until soft.
Split it open, spoon over the warmed beans and sprinkle with grated cheese.

dishes.name: Chicken, avocado and rice bowl
steps: Use rice cooked the day before, and leftover chicken or a chicken breast pan-fried in the oil and sliced.
Top the rice with the chicken, shredded lettuce, corn and sliced avocado, and squeeze over the lemon.

dishes.name: Hummus, rice crackers and vegetable sticks
steps: Cut the carrot and cucumber into sticks and halve the tomato.
Serve with the hummus and rice crackers for dipping.

A cheese stick and an apple

none.name: Strength A
items: Warm-up (5 minutes): march on the spot and swing your arms
Sit to stand (3 × 10): stand up from a chair and sit back down slowly
Wall push-up (3 × 10): hands on the wall, lower your chest towards it
Glute bridge (3 × 12): lie on your back, knees bent, lift your hips
Bird dog (3 × 8 each side): on hands and knees, reach one arm and the opposite leg
Cool-down (3 minutes): gentle stretches

none.name: Strength B
items: Warm-up (5 minutes): march on the spot
Step-up (3 × 8 each leg): onto the bottom stair, holding the rail
Incline push-up (3 × 8): hands on a bench or kitchen bench
Calf raise (3 × 15): hold something steady
Dead bug (3 × 8 each side): lie on your back, slowly lower opposite arm and leg
Cool-down (3 minutes): gentle stretches

bands.name: Strength A
items: Warm-up (5 minutes): march on the spot and arm circles
Squat to a chair (3 × 10): sit back until you touch the chair, then stand
Band row (3 × 12): band around something sturdy, pull your elbows back
Band chest press (3 × 10): band behind your back, push forward
Glute bridge (3 × 12): band around your knees
Cool-down (3 minutes): gentle stretches

bands.name: Strength B
items: Warm-up (5 minutes): march on the spot
Reverse lunge (3 × 8 each leg): hold a chair for balance if needed
Band pull-apart (3 × 12): arms straight, pull the band apart
Band overhead press (3 × 10): stand on the band, press up
Side plank on knees (3 × 20 seconds each side)
Cool-down (3 minutes): gentle stretches

dumbbells.name: Strength A
items: Warm-up (5 minutes): march on the spot and arm circles
Goblet squat (3 × 10): hold one dumbbell at your chest
One-arm dumbbell row (3 × 10 each side): hand on a bench
Dumbbell floor press (3 × 10): lying on your back
Romanian deadlift (3 × 10): soft knees, hinge at the hips
Plank (3 × 20 to 30 seconds)
Cool-down (3 minutes): gentle stretches

dumbbells.name: Strength B
items: Warm-up (5 minutes): march on the spot
Reverse lunge (3 × 8 each leg): dumbbells at your sides
Dumbbell shoulder press (3 × 10): seated or standing
Glute bridge (3 × 12): dumbbell on your hips
Dumbbell curl (2 × 12)
Dead bug (3 × 8 each side)
Cool-down (3 minutes): gentle stretches

gym.name: Strength A
items: Warm-up (5 minutes): bike or cross-trainer
Leg press (3 × 10): feet shoulder-width apart
Lat pulldown (3 × 10): pull the bar to your upper chest
Chest press machine (3 × 10)
Seated leg curl (3 × 12)
Plank (3 × 30 seconds)
Cool-down (5 minutes): easy bike and stretches

gym.name: Strength B
items: Warm-up (5 minutes): bike or cross-trainer
Goblet squat (3 × 10): dumbbell at your chest
Seated cable row (3 × 10)
Shoulder press machine (3 × 10)
Romanian deadlift (3 × 10): dumbbells, soft knees
Cable woodchop (2 × 10 each side)
Cool-down (5 minutes): easy bike and stretches

seated.name: Strength A
items: Warm-up (5 minutes): seated arm circles and shoulder rolls
Seated band row (3 × 12): band around a sturdy post
Seated chest press (3 × 10): band behind your back, or a light weight
Seated overhead press (3 × 10): light weights or water bottles
Seated twist (2 × 8 each side): slow and controlled
Cool-down (3 minutes): gentle neck and shoulder stretches

seated.name: Strength B
items: Warm-up (5 minutes): seated marching or arm swings
Seated bicep curl (3 × 12): light weights or a band
Seated lateral raise (3 × 10): light weights
Seated leg lift (3 × 10 each, if you can): straighten one knee
Breathing and posture (3 minutes): sit tall, slow breaths
Cool-down (3 minutes): gentle stretches
